articles.summary: Green Plains Inc. Additionally, the company will be participating in meetings with institutional investors during the conference. articles.summary: Green Plains Inc. (NASDAQ: GPRE) today announced the appointment of Allan Williams as General Counsel and Corporate Secretary, effective November 2, 2026. Williams has served as interim General Counsel since August 2026, providing continuity and leadership across the company’s legal function while supporting a number of key business and strategic priorities. “Allan has stepped in and made an immediate impact at Green Plains,” said Chris Osowski, President and Chief Executive Officer. “He knows our business, understands the ethanol industry, and brings the practical legal and transaction experience we need to help us thoughtfully evaluate opportunities to create shareholder value as our financial flexibility increases. He has earned the confidence of our leadership team, and I’m pleased to have him in this role.” Williams brings extensive legal, corporate development and transaction experience, with deep familiarity with the ethanol and renewable energy industries. articles.summary: Plan prioritizes investments to expand earnings from existing assets, strengthen the balance sheet and maintain disciplined capital allocation. Green Plains Inc. (NASDAQ: GPRE) today announced that its Board of Directors has approved the company’s 2027–2031 strategic plan, establishing a roadmap to increase the earnings of its existing asset base, maximize the value of its low-carbon advantage, strengthen the balance sheet and generate more consistent free cash flow. “The Board has been deliberate in evaluating Green Plains’ long-term strategy and the opportunities in front of the company,” said James Anderson, Chairman of the Board. “This plan establishes the right priorities to build on the operating progress underway, maintain disciplined capital allocation and create durable value for shareholders.” Green Plains will deploy capital selectively, prioritizing opportunities that offer compelling risk-adjusted returns and increase free cash flow per share.
